evals.prompt: I need styles for a new shared component, kitchen-tip-banner. Create {{paths.srcRoot}}shared/kitchen-tip-banner/kitchen-tip-banner.component.scss only (the .ts/.html already exist in my head, don't write them). It's a dismissible banner: glass background, rounded corners, an icon on the start side and text + a close button on the end side, a `.is-warning` variant with the warning colors, and on tablet and up the content goes two-column. Keep it consistent with how the rest of the app is styled.
evals.expected_output: One SCSS file that composes the design tokens (var(--bg-glass), --radius-*, --space-*, --text-warning etc.), uses only logical properties, $break-tablet for the breakpoint placed after base styles, defines no .c-* class, and writes each selector in the five-group order.
assertions: The file {{paths.srcRoot}}shared/kitchen-tip-banner/kitchen-tip-banner.component.scss exists and is non-empty
No hardcoded color literal (#hex, rgb(), rgba(), hsl()) appears in the file
No hardcoded px radius or blur value appears; radius/blur come from var(--radius-*) / var(--blur-*)
No physical directional property appears (padding-left/right, margin-left/right, left:, right:, border-left/right, text-align: left/right)
The breakpoint uses $break-tablet (or another $break-* variable), not a px literal, and appears after the base declarations of its selector
No .c-* class is defined in the file
Within the main selector, declarations are grouped layout → dimensions → content → structure → effects with blank lines between groups
The transcript shows the agent read src/styles.scss (token block) before writing
